summary.headline: Astrological Lots and Their Formulas
summary.text: Astrological account of the lots Victory, Nemesis, and the Basis or Horoskopos, followed by a diurnal list of lots for foreign travel, finding, theft, heirs, loans, death, enemies, authority, victory, estates, livelihood, rank, tribunals, and sorrow, with formulas assigning planetary distances. The notes cite Paulus, Rhetorius, Boll, and manuscript folio 132r, and state that nocturnal births use the opposite arrangement.
